_doc: Units modelled before their unit_specs.json entry exists. unit_specs.json belongs to the balance engineer, so it is not edited here. ulib.py, lods.py and sandbox/build_assets.py read this file only for ids that unit_specs.json does not have: once the real entry lands it wins, and the entry below can be deleted. Only the fields the model pipeline reads are given (envelope, triangle budget, labels).

units.name: Halo Anti-Air Carrier
units._budget_note: A03 Lancer's budget, as the brief asks for A03-level triangle counts at each LOD
